# Autogenerated Mermaid Diagrams — Design Spec

- **Status:** Approved (design); implementation not started
- **Date:** 2026-07-02
- **Linear:** [MM-29](https://linear.app/mark-mansour/issue/MM-29/autogenerate-mermaid-diagrams-for-docs-class-sequence)
- **Scope:** Class, data-model (ER), and sequence diagrams for the `core/` (`saddlery`) system,
  in [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/), to help understand the system as it's built.
- **Related:** [pyreverse](https://pylint.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pyreverse.html)
  (ships with [pylint](https://pylint.readthedocs.io/)),
  [`docs/conventions/python.md`](../conventions/python.md),
  [`docs/specs/2026-06-24-python-standards-design.md`](2026-06-24-python-standards-design.md)

## 1. Context & goal

Agent Saddlery is a learning project. As the headless Python core grows, diagrams make the
structure and behavior legible. This spec adds **autogenerated class + data-model diagrams** and a
**hand-authored sequence diagram**, all in Mermaid so they render inline in GitHub and Linear with
no external renderer. The recently-enforced strict typing (see `docs/conventions/python.md`) makes
the code readable to the structure tools.

## 2. Goals / non-goals

**Goals**
- A class diagram of the `saddlery` package, autogenerated.
- An entity-relationship diagram of the Pydantic/dataclass data model, autogenerated.
- A hand-authored sequence diagram of the 0.1 echo loop.
- One command to regenerate; a CI smoke-check that generation still runs on current code.

**Non-goals (deferred)**
- Autogenerated sequence diagrams (runtime tracing) — behavior is hand-drawn; that's the learning value.
- A strict freshness/diff gate in CI (see §3) — smoke-check only, to avoid false failures.
- The pyreverse package diagram — a near-free follow-on, out of the first cut.
- Any repo-layout change (e.g. renaming `core/`) — tracked separately if pursued.

## 3. Decisions (with rationale)

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Format | **Mermaid everywhere** | Renders inline in GitHub + Linear; fits the devlog + link-references workflow; no renderer to install. |
| Class diagram | **pyreverse → Mermaid `classDiagram`** | Reads the typed code directly; ships with pylint; emits Mermaid. |
| Data model | **Custom generator → Mermaid `erDiagram`** | pyreverse emits `classDiagram` not `erDiagram`; erdantic emits SVG (breaks Mermaid-only) and needs Graphviz. A small Pydantic-introspection script keeps it all-Mermaid and stays current. |
| Sequence diagram | **Hand-authored Mermaid** | Static autogeneration is unreliable; drawing the intended interaction is the point. |
| Freshness | **CI smoke-check only** | Generator must run clean (catches a generator broken by model changes); no output diff, so non-deterministic ordering can't cause false failures. Diagrams are refreshed and committed by hand. |
| Build handle | **`make` over `just`** | `just` isn't installed and would need adding locally + in CI; `make` is universally available. The real work is a `uv run` command. |
| Tooling location | **`core/scripts/gen_diagrams.py`** | Inside the gated `core/` project (ruff/ty/pytest cover it); named `scripts` to avoid colliding with `saddlery/tools/` (agent tools); no repo restructure. |

## 4. Components

- **`pylint`** added to the `core` `dev` dependency group (provides `pyreverse`), pinned in `uv.lock`.
- **`core/scripts/gen_diagrams.py`** — the orchestrator, split so logic is testable:
  - `render_er(models) -> str` — **pure**: walks Pydantic `.model_fields` → Mermaid `erDiagram` text.
  - `render_class_md(mmd: str) -> str` — wraps raw pyreverse `.mmd` in a fenced ```mermaid block
    with a caption and a "generated — do not edit" banner.
  - `main()` — resolves repo paths, shells to `pyreverse -o mmd` over `saddlery/`, calls the
    renderers, writes the `docs/diagrams/*.md` files. Exercised by the CI smoke run, not unit-tested.
- **`core/tests/test_gen_diagrams.py`** — unit-tests `render_er` against the real event models
  (asserts the entities, a discriminated-union relationship, and a field type appear in the output).
- **`core/scripts/__init__.py`** — makes `scripts` importable from `tests/` (import mode).

## 5. Output layout

`docs/diagrams/` holds **markdown files with fenced `mermaid` blocks** (raw `.mmd` files do not
render on GitHub):

| File | Source | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `class-core.md` | generated | pyreverse `classDiagram` of `saddlery` |
| `events-er.md` | generated | `erDiagram` of the event models + `Message` |
| `echo-loop-sequence.md` | hand-authored | `sequenceDiagram` of the 0.1 echo loop |
| `README.md` | hand-authored | index: which files are generated vs hand-authored, and `make diagrams` to regenerate |

Generated files carry a banner comment identifying them as generated by
`core/scripts/gen_diagrams.py`.

## 6. Wiring

- **`Makefile`** (repo root): `diagrams:` → `cd core && uv run python scripts/gen_diagrams.py`.
  A human handle; nothing depends on `make` existing.
- **CI**: one new step in the existing `.github/workflows/python-core.yml` job runs
  `uv run python scripts/gen_diagrams.py` (working-directory `core`). Must exit 0 (smoke). **No
  diff gate.** Runs on the existing 3.12/3.14 matrix.
- **pre-commit**: unchanged (diagram generation is smoke-only, too slow/noisy for a commit hook).

## 7. The echo-loop sequence diagram (content)

Hand-authored `sequenceDiagram` showing the 0.1 path, drawn from `saddlery/`:
CLI entrypoint → `Agent.run(session, sink)` → append `RunStarted` (Session + Sink) →
`LLMProvider.stream(messages, model)` → per delta: append `AssistantMessageDelta` (Session + Sink) →
`AssistantMessage` → `RunFinished` in `finally`; `ErrorEvent` on exception. Participants: CLI,
Agent, Session, LLMProvider, EventSink.

## 8. Testing

- `render_er` is a pure function → unit test in `core/tests/test_gen_diagrams.py`.
- The pyreverse subprocess and file I/O in `main()` are covered by the CI smoke step, not unit tests.
- `core/scripts/` is under the ruff + ty gate; the whole change keeps the existing suite green.

## 9. Success criteria

- `make diagrams` (or `uv run python scripts/gen_diagrams.py` from `core/`) writes
  `docs/diagrams/class-core.md` and `docs/diagrams/events-er.md` with valid fenced Mermaid.
- `docs/diagrams/echo-loop-sequence.md` and `docs/diagrams/README.md` exist and render.
- `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ty check`, and `uv run pytest -q` pass on `core/`.
- CI runs the generator as a smoke step and it exits 0 on 3.12 and 3.14.
- No change to runtime behavior of `saddlery`.
